name: Utilisation Report
query:
SELECT
    expense.budget_plan AS budget_plan,
    '' AS category,
    '' AS subcategory,
    SUM(expense.total_utilised_amount) AS utilised_amount,
    NULL AS parent_budget,
    0 AS indent
FROM
    `tabExpense` expense
GROUP BY
    expense.budget_plan

UNION ALL

SELECT
    expense.budget_plan AS budget_plan,
    expense_tracker.category AS category,
    '' AS subcategory,
    SUM(expense_tracker.utilised_amount) AS utilised_amount,
    expense.budget_plan AS parent_budget,
    1 AS indent
FROM
    `tabExpense` expense
    INNER JOIN `tabExpense Item Child Table` expense_tracker
        ON expense_tracker.parent = expense.name
GROUP BY
    expense.budget_plan, expense_tracker.category

UNION ALL

SELECT
    expense.budget_plan AS budget_plan,
    expense_tracker.category AS category,
    expense_tracker.subcategory AS subcategory,
    SUM(expense_tracker.utilised_amount) AS utilised_amount,
    CONCAT(expense.budget_plan, expense_tracker.category) AS parent_budget,
    2 AS indent
FROM
    `tabExpense` expense
    INNER JOIN `tabExpense Item Child Table` expense_tracker
        ON expense_tracker.parent = expense.name
GROUP BY
    expense.budget_plan, expense_tracker.category, expense_tracker.subcategory
ORDER BY
    budget_plan, category, subcategory
